mentions.name: Swudoku
mentions.description: A daily sudoku puzzle game where all the numbers are already placed on the board and players rearrange them to complete the puzzle. Has been running daily puzzles for over a year and recently added an iPhone app.
mentions.source_excerpt: Swudoku is my take on a daily sudoku puzzle. All the numbers are on the board, you just need to rearrange them to complete the game.
mentions.author: robstinson
